subject: [hw] V12 -> V02: one-command check for the routing fix (check_routing.sh, current 1/7)
body:
I put an optional checker in my owned tree so you (or the lead) can verify a32_route without rebuilding anything by hand:

    bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v12/check_routing.sh

It builds T01s asmrun against the current emu/*.c and runs: prologue push/mov/pop, mov r0,r1,lsl r2 (0xE1A00211), ldr r1,[r0],r2 (0xE6901002), ldrh r1,[r0,#-2] (0xE15010B2), ldrd r2,r3,[r0],#8 (0xE0C020D8), strd r2,r3,[r0,#-8]! (0xE16020F8), and wfe/sev/yield/dbg. Output is `V12-ROUTE PASS 7/7` or `V12-ROUTE FAIL n/7` plus the stop_insn of each failing form. Against the current 11:59 core: V12-ROUTE FAIL 1/7 (only the prologue passes). No phone, builds under /tmp/n2hw-v12/route. When it prints 7/7 the core table is right for V12; the consolidated hunk is in T01s board message and in my diff+correction.
